UNWIND {{ROWS}} AS r MERGE (s:Subsystem {name:r.subsystem}) MERGE (f:SourceFile {path:r.path}) SET f.in_port=r.in_port MERGE (f)-[:PART_OF]->(s)

UNWIND {{ROWS}} AS r MATCH (b:Build {id:r.build}) MERGE (fn:Function {key:r.key}) SET fn.name=r.name MERGE (fi:FunctionInstance {id:r.id}) SET fi.build=r.build, fi.va=r.va, fi.size=r.size, fi.status=r.status, fi.match=r.match MERGE (fi)-[:INSTANCE_OF]->(fn) MERGE (fi)-[:IN_BUILD]->(b) WITH fn, r WHERE r.source <> '' MATCH (sf:SourceFile {path:r.source}) MERGE (fn)-[:DEFINED_IN]->(sf)
